jobDescription: Role Overview Zee is looking for a motivated and hands-on Cyber Security Analyst – Vulnerability Management & Threat Intelligence Specialist to join our growing cybersecurity team. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment tools, threat intelligence platforms, security analytics, and automation, along with a proactive security mindset. Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting • Monitor, analyze, and investigate emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends using Cloud SEK, Mandiant, and other threat intel sources. • Conduct dark web and OSINT monitoring to identify data leaks, credential exposure, brand abuse, or targeted threats. • Correlate threat intelligence with internal security events using SIEM platforms in collaboration with the SOC team. • Support proactive threat-hunting activities leveraging frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. • Analyze Io Cs and translate them into detection and prevention use cases. Security Automation & Engineering • Assist in automating vulnerability management and threat intelligence workflows using SOAR platforms and scripting (Python/Power Shell preferred). • Leverage AI/ML-based security tools where applicable to improve detection, enrichment, prioritization, and reporting. • Integrate threat intelligence feeds with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools. Web Application & WAF Security • Support Web Application Firewall (WAF) operations, including rule tuning, false-positive analysis, and incident investigation. • Collaborate with application security teams to align WAF controls with application-level risks and vulnerabilities. Reporting & Stakeholder Management • Prepare and present clear, risk-based reports on vulnerability posture, remediation status, and threat landscape for senior management. • Provide actionable intelligence briefings highlighting emerging threats and potential business impact. • Act as a trusted security advisor to internal stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence, or SOC operations. • Strong experience with Qualys (or similar vulnerability management platforms). • Hands-on experience with threat intelligence platforms such as Cloud SEK, Mandiant, Recorded Future, or equivalent. • Working knowledge of SIEM tools and security event analysis. • Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and attacker TTPs. • Basic scripting or automation experience (Python, Power Shell, or similar). • Familiarity with WAF technologies and web application security concepts. • Good understanding of networking, operating systems, and common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, CVEs, CWEs). • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills. Good to Have (Added Value) • Security certifications are a strong plus, such as: • CEH, Security+, GSEC • Vendor-specific certifications (Qualys, cloud security, SIEM, WAF) • Exposure to cloud security (AWS / Azure / GCP) environments. • Experience integrating or using AI/ML-driven security platforms for risk prioritisation or threat detection. • Experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development. • Prior experience in a media, OTT, or large-scale enterprise environment. Why Join Zee? • Opportunity to work in a large, complex, and high-visibility environment. • Hands-on exposure across vulnerability management, threat intelligence, automation, and WAF security. • Strong growth path into senior security engineering, purple team, or threat-hunting roles.
